text: Fish DSH 插件聚合包面向 DSH Web 客户端，把十一个独立扩展以固定版本挂载到配置中。成员涵盖审批说明、Git 配置同步、技能浏览、设置导航、视觉伴侣、任务看板、Git 图谱、SSH 运维、用量统计、会话归档和 AgentTeams。它通过 bundle 插入成员插件行，适合希望一次安装多种工作流扩展的 DSH 用户。安装需符合 Node.js 版本要求；部分功能依赖本机 Git、SSH 或模型运行环境。

Fish DSH bundles eleven version-pinned extensions for the DSH web client, including Git sync, skill browsing, task boards, SSH operations, usage tracking, session archiving, and AgentTeams. A profile patch mounts the packages together; some features rely on local Git, SSH, or model facilities.
我想一次给 DSH 装上常用的工作流插件。
有没有能把 DSH 配置通过 Git 同步到另一台机器的扩展？
我想在 DSH 里用 SSH 管理远程主机和终端。
能不能在网页里查看和管理 DSH 会话归档？
我需要一个看板来安排 DSH 任务和定时执行。
I want to install a collection of workflow extensions for DSH in one go.
Can I browse and manage archived DSH sessions from the web interface?
I need a DSH task board with scheduled and agent-driven work.
Fish DSH 聚合包中的 Git Sync 功能：将选定的 DSH 配置采集到 Git 仓库，并支持拉取、推送和还原；用户通过设置面板操作。
Fish DSH 聚合包中的任务看板：在 DSH 内管理任务和执行状态，并提供会话复用与轮询调度逻辑。
Fish DSH 聚合包中的会话归档功能：在界面中集中检索和筛选会话，并管理会话归档状态。
Fish DSH 聚合包中的 SSH 功能：管理 SSH 主机并提供 SSH 客户端、终端与网络能力所需的宿主实现。
Fish DSH 聚合包中的技能中心：扫描 DSH 技能文件并提供文件读取、编辑和管理的宿主能力。

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-fish@1.0.5
```

安装后重启 DSH。桌面版无 CLI 时在插件管理器添加同名包。需要 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`；AgentTeams 推荐宿主 `0.2.0-rc.2`，`0.2.1-rc.2` 保持预览支持。各成员的宿主声明分别生效。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · 本次更新：**破甲不再是内置成员**：本版把 `@fish-under-sea/dsh-purge-fish` 从依赖与 `cordis.patch.yml` 中一并移除。原因不在插件本身，而在 npm 对该新包名启用了 staged publish 审核：`1.0.2`、`1.0.4` 都只落下一个 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版本，真实版本迟迟无法上架，导致聚合包安装时依赖解析失败、整个包装不上。破甲仍可单独安装，见下方「可选：单独安装破甲」。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · 可选：单独安装破甲：破甲 `@fish-under-sea/dsh-purge-fish` **不在聚合内**，需要时单独安装。它给所有模型注入可替换的清洗提示词，可按模型分别配置，并带红队演练台（预设、技能、SQLite 事实库、HTTP 桥）与一键回滚。

等它通过 npm 审核后按常规安装：

```sh

```

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · 可选：单独安装破甲：单装时由它自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 完成宿主提示改写（关闭 harness 身份段、清空 `personaPrefix`、`personaSuffix` 换成不插值的固定句）并停用五个旧独立红队行；聚合不再代做这些改写。行 id `dsh-purge` 与数据目录 `$DSH_HOME/redteam` 不变。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · 从旧版迁移：- 先安全备份 `$DSH_HOME`、profile 清单和补丁；本地 link 插件源码需另外备份。
- AgentTeams 包名改为 `@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish`。替换旧直接依赖和 bundle 引用；若 profile 覆盖行中写了旧 `name`，一并修改。行 id `agent-teams`、状态目录 `.agent-teams` 和配置键不变。不要把新旧包同时挂载。
- 破甲从 1.0.5 起不再内置：升级聚合后，`dsh-purge`、`dsh-purge-redteam`、`dsh-purge-redteam-store`、`dsh-purge-redteam-ui` 四行与宿主 `system-prompt` 改写都不会再由聚合注入。需要破甲就按上面「可选：单独安装破甲」加装；不需要则无需处理，profile 里残留的同名覆盖行可以直接删掉。
- Better Reasoning Effort 不再内置。需要时从 [HaoyueQin 官方仓库](https://github.com/HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort)安装 `dsh-better-reasoning-effort`，不要继续使用 Fish Fork。
- Video Preview 不再提供；OFM 与旧会话标题插件也不在本聚合中，不提供替代依赖。已有用户数据不会因发布本包被删除。
- 更新聚合包不会自动清掉 profile 中单独添加的旧包、bundle 或覆盖行。请在插件管理器核对并移除对应旧项后再重启。
- 历史损坏会话不属于版本号迁移可修复范围；不要为升级手工删除日志事件。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · 共存与数据：不要同时启用同功能的上游 `dsh-web-all` 行和 Fish 行；不同 id 也可能重复注册服务。Skill Lens 与上游版共用 `skill-lens` 行 id，不能重复插入。本聚合只插入自己的 11 行，不改写宿主 `system-prompt`，也不停用旧独立红队行——这些改写已随破甲移交给它自己的单装包。不改变宿主内置标题功能。

配置与业务数据保留在 `$DSH_HOME` 或工作区中，不写死机器路径。SSH 凭据可能明文保存；会话物理删除不可撤回；Git 同步不等于完整备份；调度和团队执行消耗真实模型额度。详见各成员 README 的安全边界。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · 开发与来源：以下检查按需手动执行，不是提交或发布前置门禁。本仓库不配置 push / PR 自动验证；标签发布不运行构建或测试。子包共用本仓库策略，插件运行时的权限与数据保护规则不变。

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test:release
pnpm -r --if-present typecheck

聚合自身是空实现，挂载入口是 `cordis.patch.yml`。成员独立构建、独立发布；浏览器模块必须以实际包名重新构建。聚合包版本与成员版本分开推进：1.0.5 是聚合包自身版本，成员按各自发布版本精确固定，不声称已同步所有上游 HEAD。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-fish@1.0.5
```

Restart DSH after installation. With no desktop CLI, add the same package in the plugin manager. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`. AgentTeams recommends Host `0.2.0-rc.2`; `0.2.1-rc.2` remains preview-supported. Every member retains its own Host compatibility declaration.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · What's New：**Jailbreak is no longer a bundled member**: this release drops `@fish-under-sea/dsh-purge-fish` from both the dependency list and `cordis.patch.yml`. The cause is not the plugin but npm: that new package name is subject to staged publishing review, so `1.0.2` and `1.0.4` only ever produced a `0.0.0-stage` placeholder while the real versions never shipped — which made the bundle unresolvable at install time, so the whole bundle could not be installed. Jailbreak can still be installed on its own; see “Optional: install Jailbreak separately” below.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · What's New：Retained from the previous release: Settings Navigation owns icons, localized titles and ordering for four extension commands, defaulting to **Agent Teams → Visual Companion → Context Compression → Cache Statistics** (`agent-teams → companion → acp → acp-cache`). Adjust and save under **Settings → 设置导航顺序 → 斜杠菜单顺序**; preferences live in the browser and `$DSH_HOME/dsh-settings-nav-order/state.json`.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Optional: install Jailbreak separately：Jailbreak (`@fish-under-sea/dsh-purge-fish`) is **not included in the bundle**. Install it on its own when wanted: it injects replaceable cleaning prompts for every model, configurable per model, and ships a red-team bench (presets, skills, SQLite fact store, HTTP bridge) plus one-click rollback.

Once it clears npm review, install it the usual way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-purge-fish@1.0.4
```

Before that, install from the GitHub source:

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Optional: install Jailbreak separately：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/Fish-under-sea/dsh-purge/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz
```

When installed standalone, its own `cordis.patch.yml` performs the host prompt rewrite (disables the harness identity section, clears `personaPrefix`, replaces `personaSuffix` with a non-interpolating sentence) and disables the five legacy red-team rows; the bundle no longer does any of this. The `dsh-purge` row id and the `$DSH_HOME/redteam` data directory are unchanged.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Migration：- Securely back up `$DSH_HOME`, profile manifests and patches; separately back up local linked plugin source.
- AgentTeams moves to `@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish`. Replace old direct dependencies and bundle references, including any profile row overriding the old `name`. The `agent-teams` row id, `.agent-teams` state directory and configuration keys stay unchanged. Never mount old and new packages together.
- Jailbreak is no longer bundled as of 1.0.5: after upgrading, none of the four rows (`dsh-purge`, `dsh-purge-redteam`, `dsh-purge-redteam-store`, `dsh-purge-redteam-ui`) nor the `system-prompt` rewrite is injected by the aggregate any more. Add it via “Optional: install Jailbreak separately” when needed; otherwise nothing to do, and leftover profile overrides for those ids can simply be removed.
- Better Reasoning Effort is no longer bundled. Use `dsh-better-reasoning-effort` from [HaoyueQin upstream](https://github.com/HaoyueQin/dsh-better-reasoning-effort), not the Fish fork.
- Video Preview is discontinued. OFM and the retired session-title plugin are not included and have no replacement dependency here. This release does n

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Coexistence and Data：Do not co-enable equivalent upstream `dsh-web-all` and Fish rows: distinct ids can still register the same services twice. Upstream Skill Lens shares the `skill-lens` id. This bundle inserts only its own eleven rows, no longer rewrites the host `system-prompt`, and no longer disables legacy red-team rows — those rewrites now belong to the standalone Jailbreak package. It never disables another package or the built-in title service.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Coexistence and Data：Configuration and data stay in `$DSH_HOME` or the workspace without hard-coded machine paths. SSH credentials may be plaintext; physical session deletion is irreversible; Git sync is not a full backup; scheduling and teams consume real model quota. Read each member safety section.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish README · Development and Attribution：The aggregate has no runtime implementation: `cordis.patch.yml` mounts independently built and published members. Rebuild client modules for their real package identity. The aggregate version moves separately from member versions: 1.0.5 is the bundle’s own version, members stay pinned to their published versions, and no claim is made that every upstream HEAD is merged.
